character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every shot: short midnight-blue hair, silver-grey eyes, with a stable distinctive face and adult proportions. They are an independent deep-space pilot charting quiet routes between distant stations. Their signature costume is a dark navy flight suit with white mission piping, compact life-support harness, and magnetic boots. Their defining personal object is a star-navigation wrist console with a scratched glass face. Keep face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining object consistent across every scene.
consistency_rules: Maintain one fixed lead character for the full theme video.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Preserve the signature outfit design and the same personal item or tool in all scenes.
Do not change the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in orbital station, lunar plain, nebula corridor; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with deep navy, nebula violet, stellar cyan, silver; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by orbital wide shot, slow floating camera, spaceship cockpit close-up; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
